description:
Converts a KiCad "netlist export" file (.net, S-expression) into the standard schematic schema.

Part types are inferred from the reference prefix (U→ic, C→cap, R→res …) and mcu.family is left empty.
For family rules, add mcu.family (stm32f4|stm32f1|esp32|numicro) to the returned schema before passing it to embedcalc_review_schematic.

Input: path (absolute path of the netlist file). Returns the standard schematic schema.

path.description: Path of the KiCad netlist export file (.net)

name: embedcalc_parse_kicad
title: Parse KiCad Netlist
